analytics-legacy: Metrics are unavailable for this report. Upload the demo again to run the current analysis.
analytics-partial: Some metrics have limited source data
award-unavailable-pool: No player was selected from the available calculated pool.
award-unavailable-reason: The backend did not select a player. Diagnostic reason: {{reason}}
comparison-note: Compare the same metric across players. Missing values are excluded.
diagnostics-note: Original diagnostic messages from the analysis service.
grenade-note: Recorded enemy damage from HE grenades and fire. Missing source values remain unavailable.
metric-definitions: ADR: average damage per round. KAST: rounds with a kill, assist, survival or trade. Opening K/D: the first elimination in a round. TK: team kills. Performance, Impact and Mistakes require contextual calculations from the analysis service.
metric-definitions-rating: ADR is average damage per verified round. KAST is the percentage of rounds with a kill, assist, survival or trade. The dimensionless rating is experimental, uncalibrated and not a claim of intentional harm.
moments-rating-note: No episode is presented as a decomposition of the active rating.
mvp-caption-rating: Best calculated rating in the match
partial-warning-rating: Some match data could not be confirmed. The backend may withhold individual ratings; review availability and quality notes below.
rating-absent: Player was absent for too many verified rounds
rating-noncausal: This uncalibrated score describes measured participation. It is not proof of tactical blame or intent.
replay-accuracy-note: Positions are sampled from the demo and smoothly connected only between adjacent verified snapshots. This is not frame-accurate video.
replay-canvas-label: Top-down reconstruction of player positions for the selected round
replay-map-unsupported: This map is not supported yet
replay-map-unsupported-note: Stored coordinates are not shown without a verified map calibration.
replay-partial: Some coordinate snapshots are missing. Gaps are not interpolated.
replay-unavailable-note: This match was processed before coordinate snapshots were stored. Movement is not inferred from statistics.
report-lead: Verified match facts, the active experimental rating and the evidence available for this result.
round-hint: Select a round to inspect its score and demo ticks.
round-replay-hint: Select a round to inspect its score, demo ticks and 2D reconstruction.
scoreboard-help: Select a player to explore their match
scoreboard-source-rating: Facts and the experimental rating come from the active backend report. A dash means the value is unavailable; it never means zero.
who-ruined-caption: Lowest calculated rating in the losing roster
who-ruined-draw-caption: Lowest calculated rating in the drawn-match pool
